language_control.note: RETIRED 2026-09-22: the European and Canadian hunters now run one bilingual pass and emit no freeze, so this is 0/0 on every run sealed after that date. On earlier runs pre_local is each hunter's own sum after the ENGLISH pass and before the local pass; eu_resolve.py ranks it against the same realised move as the key, per market, and does not pool the UK (where the second pass varied source locality) with Germany and France (where it varied language).

note: Ranked on impact_sum: the hunters' signed per-finding sizes, added up, in points of spot. No call and no threshold -- cut wherever you like afterwards, which is what keeps the ranking question answerable at every k. `conviction` (abs of the key) is where the direction skill lives: over all events the sign is a coin flip, above the median conviction it is 74%. conviction_floor is a floor on emphasis in the note, never a filter on this file. Everything under `diagnostics` was measured as neutral or subtractive and decides nothing -- see researcher_us/EDGE_ANALYSIS.md.

findings.finding: Q3 should mechanically push cumulative profit to or past the full-year guide, making an upward revision plus a dividend increase (30% payout policy) very likely today. H1 ordinary profit was 6,361m, 72.5% of the 8,771m guide, and the company kept the guide unchanged, which implies H2 ordinary of only 2,410m, -7.6% year on year after H1 was +79%. The DBJ fund #2 transfer (191 units, ~5.0bn yen) is explicitly booked in Q3. At H1 the company said 144 contracted plus 379 on-sale vacant units were mainly for Q3 sale, against a whole-H2 renovation plan of only 618 units. My base case is Q3 OP around 2.5-3.2bn yen and cumulative ordinary around 8.8-9.4bn yen, which is 100-107% of the full-year guide. Last year the company revised at the Q3 print (2025-09-30, ordinary +20.5%) when cumulative Q3 ordinary had just passed the old full-year guide.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q3 print with a revision and dividend increase, 2025-10-01: gap +6.42%, close +3.04%. Q3 print 2024-10-01 (revision came later, 2024-12-19): +4.79%. The H1 prints without a revision were sold: 2025-07-01 -5.65% and 2026-07-01 -10.19% (kabutan: '好決算発表もサプライズ乏しく出尽くし感先行'). Stand-alone revisions were bought: 2025-05-23 +8.65% and 2026-05-14 +5.52%. So the name is bought when the guide moves and sold when it does not.
